comment: Which sent files are forms a person fills, by file name (operating/doc_fill_copies.py), first match wins. Card authorizations, bank and payment forms, time sheets and safety data sheets are left out on purpose (card numbers, money, pay data, sent as-is), and a system-made certificate of analysis is not a hand-filled form. Nothing here names a party or a person.
